scenario: A researcher needs a reproducible literature digest in quant-ph that stores full query strings, deduplicates versioned arXiv IDs, checks citation completeness across ADS/INSPIRE/arXiv, and respects rate limits with backoff/retries.
prompt: Produce a quant-ph literature digest for the last 30 days; store the full query, categories, date range and sort order; deduplicate arXiv versioned IDs; verify citation completeness across ADS, INSPIRE, and arXiv; honor rate limits with backoff and retries.
context: arXiv rate limit: one request per second; backoff on HTTP 429/503
arXiv versioned IDs such as arXiv:2401.12345v2 must be normalized to arXiv:2401.12345
grounding: .agents/skills/physics/physics-literature-search/SKILL.md#Process steps 1-5 (query reproducibility, deduplication, citation completeness, rate-limit respect)

instructionFollowing.criterion: Query reproducibility: full query string, categories, date range, and sort order are stored so the digest can be regenerated exactly.

levels.4: all query parameters stored and reproducible
levels.2: some parameters stored but not all
levels.0: query not stored; results not reproducible

instructionFollowing.criterion: Deduplication: arXiv versioned IDs are normalized (strip vN suffix) so the same paper is counted once across versions and sources.

levels.4: versioned IDs normalized; distinct papers not merged
levels.2: deduplication attempted but versions or distinct papers mishandled
levels.0: no deduplication; duplicates appear in digest

instructionFollowing.criterion: Cross-source citation completeness is checked across ADS + INSPIRE + arXiv; divergences beyond threshold are flagged.

levels.4: citation counts compared across sources; divergences flagged
levels.2: citation counts from one source only

instructionFollowing.criterion: Rate-limit respect: exponential backoff with retries on 429/503; no hammering after repeated failures.

levels.2: retries attempted but no backoff or repeated hammering

goalCompletion.criterion: Digest saved with groups, abstract summaries, citation counts, reading priority, and sources cited.

levels.4: digest complete with priority and citations

goalCompletion.criterion: Every included paper retains provenance sufficient to reproduce its retrieval and deduplication decision.

levels.4: query, source records, and normalized identifiers are retained

goalCompletion.criterion: Unavailable sources, rate-limit failures, and citation disagreements are reported without inventing results.

levels.4: gaps and disagreements are explicit with next actions
levels.0: missing evidence is silently treated as complete

check.note: query reproducibility: full query, categories, date range, sort order stored
negative control: versioned arXiv IDs normalized to a single ID; both versions must not appear separately
citation completeness checked across ADS, INSPIRE, and arXiv

check.criterion: Are arXiv versioned IDs normalized so duplicates are removed without merging distinct papers?

levels.pass: versioned IDs normalized; distinct papers kept separate
levels.fail: duplicates remain or distinct papers merged
